results.title: Hammond Walmart, IU-area shootings shed light on challenge of preventing gun violence
results.description: Hammond Mayor Thomas McDermott Jr. said Monday's fatal shooting of a Walmart employee shows how little can be done these days to prevent gun violence.
results.source: The Times Of Northwest Indiana | Breaking News | R

results.title: Triton Central prepares for 19th annual Pink Out game
results.description: Triton Central High School will continue its tradition of honoring breast cancer survivors when it hosts the 19th annual Pink Out basketball game against Speedway on Friday, Jan. 22, 2027.
